facts.fact: The Banco de Cabo Verde page states that payment services and the issue, distribution and redemption of electronic money are regulated by Decreto-legislativo n.º 8/2018 of 28 November 2018.

The page states that access to the activity of payment institutions and e-money institutions is regulated by Decreto-legislativo n.º 9/2018 of 28 November 2018, with parts set out in BCV Aviso n.º 6/2019 on authorisation, minimum capital, own funds and safeguarding of funds.

The page states that payment institutions and e-money institutions, financial institutions distinct from banks, are authorised by the Banco de Cabo Verde under Decreto-legislativo n.º 9/2018, and that Correios de Cabo Verde may also issue e-money; it names no licensee and gives the page date 2025-01-01 only as its published date.

facts.fact: Decreto-legislativo n.º 7/2018 of 28 November 2018, promulgated 25 November 2018, sets the legal regime for the regulation, management and operation of the Cabo Verdean payment system, requires authorisation by the Banco de Cabo Verde to provide payment services or operate a system (art. 15), and enters into force thirty days after publication.

The same Boletim Oficial n.º 78 of 28 November 2018 publishes Decreto-legislativo n.º 8/2018, the regime for payment services and the issue, distribution and reimbursement of electronic money in Cabo Verde by legally authorised entities; its entry-into-force provision is not in the text held, so the date is the bulletin's publication date.
facts.system: Regime jurídico dos serviços de pagamento e da moeda eletrónica

facts.fact: The same bulletin's index lists Decreto-legislativo n.º 9/2018, the regime governing access to the activity of payment institutions and electronic money institutions, published 28 November 2018 (its text is not in the part held, so the date is the bulletin's publication date).
facts.system: Regime de acesso à atividade das instituições de pagamento e de moeda eletrónica

systems.owner: Banco de Cabo Verde (regulator and superintendent)
systems.tiers: participants, payment service providers, system operators, financial institutions

note: Decreto Legislativo 3/2018 is the foreign-exchange and external financial operations regime; it states nothing on payment providers, e-money issuers, their licensing or connection.

facts.fact: The article says Aviso n.6/2019 of 18 July 2019 on payment institutions and e-money institutions stands, and that no later changes were found in the outlet's check.
Aviso n.6/2019 sets minimum capital for payment institutions (2 million escudos for remittance only, 5 million for one service, 10 million for others) and 20 million for e-money institutions.
